subject: POC augmentation: adding L2 routing + two new intents, updated acceptance playbook
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Laura King <laura.king@nexaretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-30T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: POC augmentation: adding L2 routing + two new intents, updated acceptance playbook

Hi Laura / Nexa team,

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning — appreciated the clarity on your traffic mix and the differentiation between your checkout intents and shopper-help intents. Per our discussion, I’m proposing a small mid-trial augmentation to the scope so we can validate (a) L2 routing for premium shoppers and (b) two additional intents (price-match and return-assistant) that popped up in the QA session.

High-level ask: add the two intents to the evaluation plan and add a routing rule that routes sessions labeled as 'premium' to the higher-throughput model variant (same model family, higher token limit). We want to keep the original 3-week cadence but add discrete acceptance checks for the new items rather than extending the trial timeline.

Draft next steps:
- Redwood to produce an updated acceptance playbook (I attached a first pass). Ben, Karthik — can you review the gating criteria for L2 routing feasibility and the latency/SLO tradeoffs?
- Nexa to provide 100 sample conversations for the new intents and a doc describing your premium segmentation logic (by Fri 7/2).
- Sync call to confirm data ingest and KV-cache expectations (30 min).

Acceptance criteria (proposed, summary):
1) Intent-level accuracy: >= 84% intent classification F1 (price-match, return-assistant).
2) End-to-end 95th pct latency for premium routed traffic <= 400ms.
3) No regressions > 5 percentage points on the existing checkout intents.
4) Business-only logs exported to Nexa for 30 days — no PII stored.

If that all looks good, I’ll update the playbook and Ben will scope the dev work needed for the routing rule.

Thanks — Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
(e) evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | (m) +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: nexaretail-poc-acceptance-playbook-v1.pdf (summary of proposed gates), sample-intent-specs.csv (placeholder input schema)

From: Laura King <laura.king@nexaretail.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: NexaRetail Solutions <pilot@nexaretail.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC augmentation: adding L2 routing + two new intents, updated acceptance playbook

Thanks Evelyn — this aligns with what we discussed. Quick clarifications from our side:

- We can deliver ~120 sample conversations for price-match and ~90 for return-assistant by EOD Fri (we'll scrub doc-level PII).
- Premium segmentation is a rule-based flag: loyalty_tier >= 4 OR avg_order_value >= $150 for the last 3 purchases. I'll attach the spec to the shared Drive.
- We are fine with keeping the trial end date stable as long as the acceptance checks for the new intents are treated as parallel gates. If we need more time because of data quality, we'll flag it early.

Two asks for Redwood:
1) Do you expect any model variant change that will affect token accounting? We need to forecast cost.
2) Who will own the canary roll for the routing rule in our production-like staging? We prefer Redwood to run the initial rollout with Nexa observing.

Laura
Laura King
Head of Product, NexaRetail
laura.king@nexaretail.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-30T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC augmentation: adding L2 routing + two new intents, updated acceptance playbook

Evelyn / team — quick tech read:

- Routing: implementing a simple request-side routing rule keyed by "premium" boolean is straightforward. We'll implement as a policy in the routing layer so we can toggle by customer flag. Work estimate: 2 dev-days + 1 QA day.
- Model variant: we will use the same model family but bump to the "high-throughput-8k" variant for routed traffic. Token accounting: ~12% higher token-op cost for premium traffic due to context-window padding and resource overhead. I will add a cost-impact appendix to the playbook.
- Latency: I ran a short local bench earlier — 95th appears to be ~370ms with batching disabled for premium lane. That gives us a ~30ms safety buffer to the 400ms target, but we'll need a canary monitoring rule.

Monica — please add the KV-cache retention policy note (30 days) and an export path for Nexa-only logs.

Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Laura King <laura.king@nexaretail.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-01T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC augmentation: adding L2 routing + two new intents, updated acceptance playbook

Hi all — attaching the updated playbook (v1.1) with Ben's cost appendix and the explicit gating checklist. Summary of what changed vs v1:
- Added two intent test matrices with sample-size targets (price-match: N=100, return-assistant: N=80).
- Canary steps for routing: 0 -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48 hours with automatic rollback if error-rate delta > 2.5% or 95th latency exceeds 420ms.
- Ownership: Redwood will run the first canary and provide dashboards; Nexa will own final approval to proceed to 100%.

Action items:
- Nexa (Laura) to upload sample conversations + premium segmentation doc to the Drive by Fri 7/2.
- Redwood (Ben) to push routing policy to staging and share the canary dashboard link when ready (ETA 7/2 EOD).
- Evelyn to confirm acceptance criteria wording in the top-level SLA section.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Reliability Lead | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

Attachment: nexaretail-poc-acceptance-playbook-v1.1.pdf

From: Laura King <laura.king@nexaretail.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-02T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC augmentation: adding L2 routing + two new intents, updated acceptance playbook

All good from our side — we've uploaded the sample conversations and the segmentation spec to the Drive folder you shared. A few quick notes:

- We scrubbed PII and have the CSVs in the folder; filenames: nexaretail_price-match_samples.csv, nexaretail_return-assistant_samples.csv
- We confirm you can run the initial canary in our staging environment. We expect an internal product observer (me) plus one Eng from Nexa to monitor.
- Regarding costs: we acknowledge the ~12% uplift for premium routed traffic. We'll model that into our forecast and decide if we want Redwood to throttle premium routing after the POC.

Let's run the canary tomorrow morning if you can get the policy pushed tonight. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Laura
